translations.text: Save [me] with your right hand, and [?]. God has spoken in his holy place: I will rejoice, and I will divide [?] (euuilendi); I will measure [the valley] of the tabernacles. Gilead is mine.
And Manasseh is mine, the support of my head; Judah [is] my king; Moab [is] the cauldron of [?] (uueref des); into Edom [I will] stretch out my shoe.
To me the foreigners have become friends. Who will lead me into the fortified city? [Who] will lead me as far as Edom? Is it not you, God, [who] cast us off?
And in our strengths [?] the troubles [?]; the strength of man [?]. And he himself [will bring] our enemies to nothing. My

[praise] do not keep silent about. For the mouth of the sinner has been opened against me; against me [they spoke with] a deceitful tongue; [with words of] hatred they surrounded me; [they fought against] me without cause. [Instead of their] loving me, they slandered me; [they repaid] me evil for good.
He blessed the house of Israel; he blessed the house of Aaron; he blessed all who fear the Lord, the small together with the greater. May the Lord add to [you], upon you, upon you

and upon your sons, [your] children. Blessed [are] you by the Lord, who made heaven and earth. The heaven of heavens [belongs] to the Lord, but the earth he gave to the children of men. The dead do not praise you, Lord,
nor all those who go down into hell; but we who live bless the Lord from now and unto eternity.
I loved, because the Lord heard the voice of my prayer, for he inclined his ear to me. And in my days
I will call upon you. The sorrows of death surrounded me; the perils of hell found me; I found trouble and sorrow.
And I called upon the name of the Lord: O Lord, deliver my soul. The Lord [is] merciful and righteous, and our God shows mercy. The Lord keeps the little ones.
I was humbled, and he delivered me. Turn, my soul, to your rest, for the Lord has done good to you; for he has delivered my soul from death,
my eyes from tears, my feet from slipping.
Had it not been that the Lord was with us when men rose up against us, perhaps they would have swallowed us alive; when their fury was enraged against us, perhaps the water would have engulfed us.
Our soul passed through the torrent; perhaps our soul would have passed through unbearable water. Blessed [is] the Lord, who did not give us into captivity to their [?] (cenim). Our soul
has been snatched like a sparrow from the snare of the hunters; the snare is broken, and we are set free. Our help [is] in the name of the Lord, [who] made heaven and earth.
Those who trust in the Lord [are] like Mount Zion; he who dwells in Jerusalem will not be moved forever. Mountains [are] around it,
and the Lord [is] around his people from now and unto eternity; for [the Lord] will not leave the rod of the sinners upon the lot of the righteous,

so that the righteous do not stretch out their hands to iniquity. Do good, Lord, to the good and the upright of heart. But those [turning aside] [?] (ch erante) into bonds the Lord will lead away with those who work iniquity. Peace upon Israel.
and his bosom [fill], he who gathers sheaves. And those who passed by did not say: The blessing of the Lord upon you; we bless you in the name of the Lord.
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Lord; Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my prayer. If you keep [account of] iniquity, Lord,
Lord, who will stand it? For with you there is mercy. Because of your law I have waited for you, Lord; my soul has waited on his word; my soul has hoped in the Lord.
From the morning watch until night let Israel hope in the Lord, for with the Lord is mercy, and with him is abundant redemption, and he redeems Israel from all his iniquities.
Lord, my heart is not exalted, nor are my eyes made proud, nor have I walked in great things,
